data.name: Hotel Santiago de Compostela
data.address: C. Colón 272A, Centro, 44100 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
An 8-minute walk from Guadalajara Cathedral, this relaxed hotel in a 19th-century building is also a 9-minute walk from the Regional Museum of Guadalajara and 1 km from Mercado Libertad-San Juan de Dios.
The laid-back rooms, some with bright accent walls, feature flat-screen TVs; some have balconies. Suites are also available.
Parking and a breakfast buffet are complimentary. Other amenities include a casual restaurant and a quaint interior courtyard with a bar and a piano. There’s also meeting space and a rooftop terrace with a pool.
